scope: production input validation and monitoring; unchanged dynamics
requirements: finite positive dt, dt_bt and requested duration before loading inputs
reject zero effective integration steps and invalid integer/nonnegative controls
check every attempted state, including both horizontal velocity components
stop at first failure; accepted state/time excludes rejected attempt
peaks include all attempted steps and initial state; nonfinite values remain visible
failed CLI exits nonzero; max-steps truncation is not full-duration PASS
do not overwrite last valid checkpoint with rejected state
same legal step and forcing yield unchanged numerical state
continuous and resumed monitoring histories/statistics obey the same contract
later_stages: blocked until their configuration, actual input identities and thresholds are registered
